pass.answer: With the hook off a missing jq is INFO, not FAIL.
jq row: INFO while disabled, because the hook exits through its enabled gate before probing anything.

fail.answer: A missing jq is still FAIL while the hook is off.
The jq row is skipped while the hook is off.
It is PASS while the hook is off.
FAIL, because every notification needs jq.
With the hook off, check does not look at jq.
